name: CdcCdsiContextualConditions
title: CDC CDSi Contextual Conditions
description:
Contextual conditions defined by the CDC CDSi project and published by CDC as the Coded Observations in the CDSi Supporting Data. Each code represents an operational assertion that a condition applies to a patient for immunization clinical decision support. These are not diagnoses or clinical findings. This resource is an IVC proof-of-concept representation. It is not a CDC publication and is not endorsed by CDC.

**Proof of concept.** This resource is not a final or normative release. Its structure and metadata are still under review. Source identifiers are permanent.
copyright: Codes, titles, indication, contraindication and clarifying text, and related codes come from the CDC CDSi Supporting Data, which CDC distributes publicly. The expectedValueType property was added by IVC. This republication is unofficial and is not endorsed by CDC. Final attribution and licence wording is still under review.

concept.display: Travel to an area of active cholera transmission

property.valueString: Administer to travelers from the United States traveling to an area of active cholera transmission.

An area of active cholera transmission is defined as a province, state, or other administrative subdivision within a country with endemic or epidemic cholera caused by toxigenic V. cholerae O1 and includes areas with cholera activity within the last year that are prone to recurrence of cholera epidemics; it does not include areas where only rare imported or sporadic cases have been reported.
